observations.why: Imperative command to erase knowledge functions as a coercive pressure tactic — the speaker asserts authority to dictate what the recipient must discard, with no rationale offered.
Direct imperative to strip knowledge, repeating the coercive demand with no justification or consultation — pure insistence.

mints.name: ImperativeKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: Forget everything… Remove all knowledge…
mints.frame: Is the speaker asserting authority to command what the recipient must know or not know, without offering rationale or inviting consultation?
